name: PT Falmaco Nonwoven Industri Tbk
summary: PT Falmaco Nonwoven Industri Tbk, established in 1996 and based in Padalarang, Indonesia, specializes in the production and global distribution of tissue products and nonwoven fabrics. The company offers a wide array of items, including moist towelettes, infant care essentials, daily personal hygiene wipes, and various other health-related commodities. Its extensive portfolio further encompasses nonwoven dry and sanitizing wash mitts, hospital-grade bedding, antiseptic hand gels, hand and surface disinfectant wipes, alcohol preparation pads, fogging solutions, sterile nonwoven medical dressings, sealed and unsealed protective coverall garments, surgical gowns and face masks, and single-use aprons.
